management_remarks: Closing FY25, ICICI Bank delivered full-year Net Profit of Rs 45,210 Crore with Q4 FY25 Net Interest Margin holding firm at 4.34% despite systemic liquidity tightness. Our retail, rural, and business banking portfolios exhibited resilient credit metrics with gross slippages declining sequentially and contingency buffers fully intact at Rs 13,100 Crore. The Board recommended an increased dividend per share of Rs 11.50, reflecting confidence in our sustainable internal capital generation.
analyst_qa: On FY26 NIM outlook, potential repo rate cuts create uncertain lead-lag effects on floating-rate mortgage yields versus fixed-term deposit costs, which could keep quarterly margins volatile. We are cautious on rural agricultural slippages during seasonal quarters and continue calibrated provisioning buffers against macro headwinds. Operating expense growth is moderating, though technology talent and cybersecurity investments remain subject to regulatory mandates.
